findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: The General page has no Save button; edits that pass validation are auto-saved after a 300 ms debounce.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: The library form's default for manageCollections is false, not true.

findings.fsdQuote: Cache Size must be at least 50 MB
findings.note: Cache size has a minimum validator of 50.

findings.fsdQuote: the base URL must start and end with a slash
findings.note: Base URL is validated with a pattern that requires a leading and trailing slash.

findings.fsdQuote: A Reset to Default button restores these settings after a confirmation.
findings.note: A Reset to Default button calls resetToDefaults, which asks for confirmation first.

findings.fsdQuote: Include in Dashboard and Include in Search are turned on by default.
findings.note: Both default to true in the library form.
Default file types per library type match the table: Manga Archive+Image, Comic Archive, Book Pdf+Epub, Light Novel Epub, Image Image.
The All Annotations screen exists at /browse/annotations but the FSD does not describe it.
The Browse Genres screen exists at /browse/genres but the FSD does not describe it.
